content:
The Manifestation of Perfection does not come with time, Perfection is not bound in the expression of time, it is a reality of that goes beyond both time and space. It is the state and nature of the risen Christ, He has always been and will be how He is. This is what Creation has been groaning for, not 'who' He is, but rather the Manifestation of 'How' He is here and now. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus came to show mankind a reality beyond what the world had known, the resurrection brought into reality a life that is Perfect, this is the age of the Manifestation of Christ! Jesus is the state of Perfection, the reality of the Resurrection to all Creation.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The death of Christ was not only a payment for sins, there is so much that was wrought in His death that Creation is yet to walk in and experience. His death was the end of all death, He stripped away death from all creation, and now death is no longer in office, Jesus is the Head of all things, all things now head towards Him.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection nothing can be lost, broken or shaken, He (Jesus) is Eternal and does not change, when Creation is brought into the reality of the Resurrection, it is made as Permanent as Christ is. We are in the Age of the Kingdom, where things are permanent where there all things a hold together by the power of an Endless life. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the present day reality it is the truth that the Lord is manifesting now to all Creation. Jesus is Perfection, in His ressurrection He has made this life manifest to all, Jesus is the Life and Experience of Perfection! No longer look for a savior, a healer or a provider, He perfects all things! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is incomparable, Perfection is a state it cannot be compared or matched with anything. When Christ was rised from the dead, He brought about an existence that had never been;He manifests as a material substance that is greater than anything physical or spiritual, this substance is PERFECTION!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Manifestation of Perfection is not confined to a meeting or a building, the Church age structure was built around the meeting together of brethren. Perfection is Manifested not only to people, it is for all Creation, and it manifests in every place and to everything. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a product of Faith, it doesn't work by that measure, Perfection the Manifestation of the Risen Christ as He is, it has no bearing on what we believe or desire God to be. Christ manifested in His fullness and power is a working of God's Resurrection Life, no one can believe or prayer for it, it's a sovereign work of God's Original Purpose.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus brought the revelation of the Father to Earth, He is the Manifestation of Sonship to all creation. This is what God desires a relationship with Him that is not based on covenant and agreement. God desires sons by birth bearing His very nature and life, a Creation as Perfect as He is.  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Kingdom of God, is the place of the establishment of the royal Priesthood, the full functioning of a priest is not in religion, it is only Manifest in the Kingdom. We are called to be a priesthood that brings the reality of God to every arena that we are in this is the role of a royal priest; Kingdom expansion. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is not a King by appointment or popular vote, He is was not nominated for the Position; rather He is King of Kings by Conquest, He takes over everything, He rules the nations with a rod of Iron, all creation is subject to Him. All things are put under His feet. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Creation has no religion; atoms, molecules stars and galaxies, are real entitiee that are groaning for the manifestation of the son's of God, not to bring a creed or program, but rather to reveal the Perfection of God to all things, it the time of revelation of oneness with God. That which is PERFECT is come. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The reality that Jesus took away death has not yet been lived out and manifest to Creation. Many have known and experienced the truth that Jesus took away our sin and sickness, but the time has come to understand and experience the resurrection. Death has already been dealt with, Life and Immortality have been brought to Light, This is Perfection!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Promise of Rest is not just an issue of not working, it is the end of all labor, struggle and death. Rest is the Manifestation of the work which God wrought in Christ when He raised Him from the dead, completely experienced by Creation, after which there is nothing to desire, believe or hope for, for all things are fulfilled and experienced. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is Perfection manifested, it is not something He has or does, it is how He is. Creation is crying out for Jesus, not Jesus who walked the streets of Galilee, rather creation groans for the risen Christ He who is Perfection. This is the time for Perfection to be made manifest to all, Jesus revealed in His fullness and Glory! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection Jesus doesn't supply needs, for there are no needs to be supplied, He has brought us into His state where we own all things together with Him, this is the kingdom fullness, the totality of Wealth, not as a possession but rather as a state. As He is. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the State of all things that God has desired for creation, He is the Manifestation of Perfection in all things. All things tend towards Christ, He is the place and moment the Creation and Creator Function together as one. That which is Perfect is come
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection you don't bring God into your life, or into anything for that matter. Our prayers are not about inviting God to help or change any situation. There are no situations in Perfection, there is only the risen Christ, all things are brought into His state and reality. Nothing escapes the ressurrection, it pulls all things into it's beings. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not taught, it is not a message, it is the manifest experience of the Risen Christ to all Creation. The age is upon us that will bring about the experience of Perfection, which is the very state of Christ as He is, to all creation. The Manifestation of the Kingdom is now, that which is PERFECT is come.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The work of Salvation was brought into effect by ones belief, this is how Grace is made available to all mankind. Perfection is not experienced by belief, Perfection is manifested by kingdom conquest, all things are brought into the reality of Christ by the Power of the Holy Spirit that God wrought when He rised Jesus from the dead.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Perfection is permanent, it cannot be improved on or changed, there are no levels of Perfection there is only one state of Perfection that is Jesus the risen Christ. What the Lord desires for Creation is His fullness, that is the manifestation and experience of Love. Love is PERFECTION.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the Manifestation and experience of the ressurrection, it can only be brought into being by the fullness of the power of God! This is a life beyond what is known now it is the reality of Christ as He is, the expression of which is the end of all the groanings of Creation. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is One whom Creation is groaning for, however it is not the revelation of the Jesus that we have shown so far, Creation is groaning for the risen Christ to Manifest in His fullness. We have up to now known and revealed Him in part, but that which is PERFECT is come and that which is in part is done away with. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Worship of God that is done on Earth is one that comes from the basis of the fall of man. All the ways that people see God are based on what He has or can do for them, this form of worship makes the worshiper small and insignificant, and it a constant reminder of the his eternal deficiency. In Perfection we don't worship God on the basis of need, it is worship of oneness with Him. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

No one can define Perfection it is not a message and it cannot be put or defined in a sermon, it is the reality of Christ as He is, Perfection is to be manifested and experienced, it is the experience of all Creation, all things are called into the State of Christ. Perfection! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

There was a place where all men can experience God, that place is called Grace, revealed to us in the New Testament, now there is a state where all Creation is pulled into the experience of the Resurrection this state is PERFECTION, it is the Manifestation of Christ as He is. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

In His death Jesus did so much more than what we have come to accredit to Him for. The effects of sin and the fall where dealt with completely, but that's not all, His death completely sucked death out of all Creation, from the sub atomic level to the grandeur of the Universe, from the physical to the spiritual, He took all death from every realm and sphere. His work is Perfect!
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The whole Creation is looking to us, it's eyes fixed on those to whom Christ has revealed Himself to manifest the fullness of His person completely. The Manifestation of the Son's of God is the end of the groanings of Creation, this is PERFECTION!  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The revelation of God that has been experienced in the past times has been based on the needs of man, the sick know Him as a Healer, the sinner has known Him as the Savior. In Perfection God is manifest and experienced not as man has defined Him or needs Him to be, He is Perfect and all things are brought into Perfection.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatest revelation of God is not necessarily who He is, but rather how He is, this speaks on His complete nature and state. This cannot to be taught in finite words or explained in point form, it takes the revelation of His full manifestation that is experienced by all Creation coming into His very state of being.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection cannot be taught, it is to be experienced and manifested, you cannot tell someone about it, it is a seen and tangible reality. This is the state of the Ressurected Christ, the Father's desire is to bring all Creation into the manifested experiencial reality of the Son.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The notion of Perfection does not lay in the hands of man being able to achieve total purity in thought, word and deed, as many would think. Perfection is far removed from that, infact Perfection is not achieved, one is brought into Perfection by beholding Jesus the risen Christ as He is, and is pulled into the Manifestation of this reality by the same Power that raised Jesus from the dead.  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The death of Jesus Christ dealt completely with the issue of sin and the fall, the ressurrection brought about a New existence that had never been before, a reality of life far beyond what had been experienced. Perfection is a state of the risen Christ as He is, being totally conformed into His image. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the best of all Creation, the Head of all things, this shows that any definition of a thing that is not revealed in Christ is false. Christ is Perfection and the state of it, He is the reality of all things, all things tend towards Him.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The delusion that NO one is perfect has kept people away from God's desire for us. You cannot approach God with preconceived notions and expect Him to fit in your boxes. This is His House, He is who He is and manifests how He is in Fullness. Being raised together with Christ we were brought into Perfection! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is not a religious figure, He is the reality of Creation. Christ is the fullness of science, the fullness of governance, the completion of mathematics, the establishment of Justice; He is all in all, He is Perfection! He is the reality of all things coming into there original and final estate. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Christianity as a religion has done so much good for the Earth, it has served the cause of Christ in the Earth for Salvation. However Perfection is Manifested in the Kingdom, it is not bound to a locality or building, the Kingdom is not one of the boxes you check on when filling out a form, it is the Manifestation of How Jesus is.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The state of Christ revealed in Perfection is the manifestation of deathlessness, this is an existence that has no reference point for death in it's being, this is what all Creation is crying out for, the glorious librety of the Son's of God; Perfection! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The first coming of Jesus was the fulfillment of Hope, however His Manifestation in Perfection is not the hope of Creation, it is the end of Faith; the seen Manifestation of the desires of the Father. Perfection is the Original intent of God for all things. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

At the first coming of Christ, mankind was looking for a savior, now that salvation has been made manifest and established in the hearts of men, Creation looks out not for a savior but rather for a King, it longs for the manifestation of the sons of God, in the glory and power of the Kingdom of God; Perfection. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Saying everyone has a past and future was true of the past age. In Perfection all things are as Jesus is, there is no past or future, there is only Christ. Everything in Christ is removed from the vanity of time, rather they are in a constant state of Perfection which is as He is.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

In Perfection Jesus doesn't offer us hope, protection, or healing; He brings all things into His state, to manifest How He is. In the ressurrection, you don't need to receive anything, you are in the state of the fullness of God; Perfection! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a goal, it is Christ as He is, it is not something that you attain, it a reality that one is brought into by the same power that rised Jesus from the dead. The original purpose of God is and has always been manifesting Sons that are in the State of the Risen Christ 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

A man's best human behavior cannot earn him Perfection, in fact Perfection is far removed from the concept of morals and behavior; Perfection is a STATE OF BEING, it is the state of the risen Christ, the manifested expression of the Godhead bodily. This is complete Oneness with God by the full expression of the Holy Spirit. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Man has moved so far away from God's original purpose of Perfection, that now some even think its heretical to even speak or believe that it is possible. The total satisfaction of creation is coming into the Reality of Perfection in Christ! 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Power of the Resurrection is the Power that brings creation into the reality of Perfection, it is where Permanency is established. The desire of God is for Creation to come into it's fullness, which is the state of Christ as He is. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the Lamb that was slain even before He ever came to Earth to die, He dwells in a reality that is not subject to time. The Resurrection of Christ is not an event in time, it is His permanent state of being (past, present & future), it is the Reality of Jesus As He Is.
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The death Jesus died was the death of all things, Creation in the fall was subjected to death, and that was the direction in which all things where headed. Jesus by the power of the Holy Spirit milked the caused of death out of all things are took it to Himself and died the Perfect death. He is now the head of all things, all things tend towards CHRIST. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The fact that Jesus the sinless one actually died points so much to the truth that He fully embraced humanity and was found in like fashion as men. His ressurrection on the other hand reveals that we have fully embraced an indestructible life, being conformed into His likeness, being made one with Him in Perfection. 
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Power that God wrought when He raised Jesus from the dead was so great, it was and will ever only be used once. That is the Resurrection of all things, even now Creation is being pulled into that reality by the same power, by it God brings all things into the reality of how He is; Perfection!  
*#Teleoisis*
*#IrisToIris*
